validity.recommendation: Add OtherEnglishNames='Akkas' (Okaz is a mis-transliteration of عكاز/Akkas). Confirm P7460/P7466/P7467 are the intended 3-section split of ONE pipeline (Akkas→T1 26in / T1→K3 26in / K3→Anbar PS 24in) and that network-level length/capacity are not double-counted across the three rows.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE — REAL, corroborated by 2 independent sources. The sheet's sole cited source (Al-Jibawi, iraqieconomists.net, June 2025) states: 'SCOP is planning to construct a new dry gas pipeline that extends from the Akkas gas field to Al-Anbar power station near Hit, Al Anbar Governorate. The pipeline has three sections. The first one is 26-inch... Akkas field to T1. The second section is 26-inch and extends from T1 to K3. The third section is 24-inch... K3 to Al-Anbar power station.' Its Table 1 lists one project row 'Akkas gas field - Anbar power station 26 - 24 Dry gas' (length blank). INDEPENDENTLY, attaqa.net (2025-10-04) reports the Iraqi Council of Ministers approved the fuel pipeline from Akkas gas field (حقل عكاس) to the Al-Anbar combined-cycle power station site (Hit district, ~1,642 MW). So the project is genuinely real, not a GEM-only entity. NOTE: 'Okaz' is a transliteration variant of Akkas/Akkaz (عكاز); the field is universally 'Akkas' in Arabic/English press — recommend adding OtherEnglishNames='Akkas'. CLASSIFICATION — correct: dry-gas transmission trunk feeding a power station; Fuel=Gas and PipelineType=transmission both hold. NOT a gathering line (the wells-to-CPU gathering network is a separate July-2025 SCOP/SLB contract for Akkas field development, distinct from this trunk). DUPLICATE — P7466 shares one gem.wiki page and one source with P7460 and P7467; this is NOT a phantom double-count but the three legitimate sections of one physical pipeline: P7460 (26in) = section 1 Akkas→T1, P7466 (26in) = section 2 T1→K3, P7467 (24in) = section 3 K3→Anbar power station. Distinct endpoints/diameters, so segment granularity is defensible — flagged as caveat only so reviewer confirms no length/capacity double-counting at network level. Also distinct from the OLDER 16-inch/30km Akkas-field→Akkas-power-station line (Qaim), which is a different, shorter pipeline. ATTRIBUTION — Owner 'Iraq Ministry of Oil' reasonable (SCOP, the executing State Company for Oil Projects, is the MoO projects arm); province Al-Anbar correct; endpoints of THIS segment are tie-in points T1→K3 per Al-Jibawi. SPEC — Diameter 26in for the T1→K3 section matches Al-Jibawi exactly (single strong source; segment-level breakdown is not independently corroborated → medium). Length and Capacity are genuinely blank in GEM; Al-Jibawi gives length '-' for the whole project and no per-segment capacity, so nothing to fill without fabrication (field production targets of 100–400 MMSCFD are field output, not pipeline capacity). STATUS — still 'proposed': as of 2025-10 the Council of Ministers had only just approved the pipeline; no construction start or tender award for this trunk found.

fills.researcher_notes: Al-Jibawi states section 2 of the Akkas→Anbar-power-station line 'extends from T1 to K3', matching this segment's name; fills the blank StartLocation/EndLocation with the tie-in station codes. Single-source (segment-level detail only in Al-Jibawi) → medium. These are opaque tie-in identifiers, not geocodable place names.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Newest independent evidence is attaqa.net 2025-10-04 (postdates sheet's 2025-07-22): the Iraqi Council of Ministers had only just APPROVED the fuel pipeline from Akkas gas field to the Al-Anbar combined-cycle power station site — i.e. still pre-construction/planning ('proposed'). The power plant itself is ~95% complete and awaiting this pipeline. No construction start, tender award, or contractor announcement for THIS transmission trunk was found (the July-2025 Schlumberger/SCOP deal covers Akkas field development + a wells-to-CPU gathering network, a different scope). 'proposed' still holds. Well within dormancy thresholds — not stale.

summary: P7466 REAL and correctly classified (dry-gas transmission, Akkas→Anbar power station near Hit); confirmed (caveat): 'Okaz'=Akkas mis-transliteration and it is section 2 (T1→K3, 26in) of a 3-section pipeline split across P7460/P7466/P7467. Status confirm=proposed (CoM approval 2025-10, pre-construction).
